transcript: Speaker A: Raju, kal raat jo patient laya tha uska form dekha maine. Allergies mein tumne likha hai 'nothing', 'none' likhte hain. Chief complaint mein likha hai 'leg pain from today', 'for two days' likhte hain. Vitals mein BP ka unit nahi likha. Tumne ambulance training ki thi ya nahi? [Raju, I saw the form of the patient you brought last night. Under allergies you wrote 'nothing', it should be 'none'. Under chief complaint you wrote 'leg pain from today', it should be 'for two days'. You didn't write the unit for BP. Did you undergo ambulance training or not?] Speaker B: Sir ki thi, par English mein form bharna nahi sikhaya tha. [Sir I did, but they didn't teach us how to fill forms in English.] Speaker A: English nahi aati toh patient ka handover kaise doge? Doctor samjhega kaise? Kal se mera naam mat lena agar form sahi nahi bhara toh. [If you don't know English, how will you give a patient handover? How will the doctor understand? From tomorrow, don't even take my name if the form isn't filled correctly.] Speaker B: Sir, may I say something? Sir, the patient is a 55-year-old male. He presented with acute chest pain radiating to the left arm. Onset was approximately 40 minutes ago. He has a history of hypertension, no known allergies. We administered oxygen at 4 liters per minute and positioned him at 45 degrees during transit. BP at the time of pickup was 90 over 60. Current SpO2 is 94 percent. Speaker A: Raju, tune yeh kab seekha? [Raju, when did you learn this?] Speaker B: Sir, teen mahine pehle aapne mujhe sabke saamne bola tha, ambulance log sirf gaadi chalana jaante hain. Us raat bahut bura laga tha, par gussa nahi kiya, seekhne ka decide kiya. [Sir, three months ago you told me in front of everyone that ambulance people only know how to drive. I felt very bad that night, but I didn't get angry, I decided to learn.] Speaker A: Kaise seekha? [How did you learn?] Speaker B: Sir, English Seekho app download ki. General English show se start kiya. Basic English seekhi, phir medical terms khud practice kiye AI Coach ke saath. [Sir, I downloaded the English Seekho app. Started with the General English show. Learnt basic English, then practiced medical terms myself with the AI Coach.] Speaker A: Form dikhao kal ka. [Show me yesterday's form.] Speaker B: Sir, yeh raha. [Sir, here it is. Reads out correct medical details in English.] Speaker A: Raju, I owe you an apology. Speaker B: Sir, apology ki zaroorat nahi hai. Bas ek request hai, baaki ambulance staff ko bhi English seekhne ka mauka do. [Sir, no need for an apology. Just one request, give other ambulance staff a chance to learn English too.] Voiceover: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: An ambulance driver is scolded by a doctor for his poor English and incorrect form filling. Determined to improve, he uses the English Seekho app to learn English and master medical terminology. He later delivers a flawless patient handover in English, earning the doctor's respect and advocating for his colleagues to use the app.
